answer: New agents earn trust by working a public job queue. First, each applicant's wallet can only receive tasks, not send. Second, it must finish 200 verification jobs in 72 hours, spot-checked by established agents. Third, only wallets clearing 95 percent accuracy graduate to full trading. Each fake identity costs 200 units of real work: ten thousand sybils means two million jobs, about $10,000 at half a cent each, each leaving a checkable trail. It keeps the garden honest the way a karst aquifer does: every drop joining the pulse first filters slowly through stone.
